Hi Sofie — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers + an initial pricing sketch below. Attaching a compact pricing worksheet for procurement.

Summary (pilot-friendly options):
- HSM seats: billed monthly for pilot; one-month minimum. Option A: pay-per-seat at $2,500/month/seat. Option B: 1-seat discounted pilot rate $1,750/month for 3-month pilot (prepay or invoice).
- Residency: pilot residency charge normally $3,000/month for dedicated residency per region; for 3-month pilot we can offer a 40% pilot concession (so $1,800/month) provided there is commitment to production within 6 months or a rollback clause.
- Audit logs: tiered retention: 30d ($0.02/GB/mo), 90d ($0.05/GB/mo), 365d ($0.12/GB/mo). We can structure a capped pilot bucket (e.g., first 500GB included) to reduce initial TCO.

Ask from our side: confirm expected QPS and estimated log volume so we can fix the included bucket.

Attachments: pricing_table_v2.xlsx (xlsx) — compact breakdown and two concession scenarios

If that looks ok I can coordinate with finance for discount approval and send a revised SOW + DocuSign link.

Hi Sofie / Allen / Procurement team,

Thanks for the patience — we've formalized the pilot pricing and updated the SOW per internal approvals. Summary of the final offer for a 3-month pilot: 

1) HSM seat: 1 seat at $1,750/month (monthly invoiced). One-month minimum, refundable credit if you move to production within 60 days after pilot end (credit = 50% of pilot spend on the HSM seat, applied across first two production months).

2) Residency: US residency at $1,800/month for 3 months (40% pilot concession from standard $3,000/month). If MedBridge converts to production within 6 months, standard residency fees apply retroactively and we will credit 50% of the pilot concession across the first 12 months of production (this is to align incentives and cover capacity reservation).

3) Audit logs: 500GB included for pilot at 90d retention. Overage at $0.05/GB/month. If you require 365d retention we can provide a separate estimate — typically ~2.4x the 90d cost due to storage and indexing.

Legal & commercial notes:
- We will issue a single amendment to the attached SOW (MedBridge_SOW_v2.pdf) covering these terms and the billing schedule.
- DocuSign link will be provided for signature; once signed we can schedule the residency cutover and HSM provisioning (expected lead time 5 business days).
